entries.name: Enforcement hooks
entries.what: Hooks that refuse a helper on the wrong model, a fan-out without a limit or a fresh meter reading, an edit of archived evidence, a call past a session's window ceiling, and rounds of review nobody asked for; with their tests and the eight lean helper types.
entries.number: Their tests pass (202, 37, 36, 25 and 17 cases) and each was seen refusing a real call

entries.name: Journal tool and commit check
entries.what: The only way a record is added to the record book, and the check that refuses a commit which changes evidence or a journal line.
entries.number: 19 commit-check tests pass and all 4,131 journal records pass its rules

entries.name: Lane and landing scripts
entries.what: The queue that runs checks side by side and the script that lands a finished unit through the check.
entries.number: 780 commands went through the lane in the build; the tree's test suite went from 596 s to 120 s with four files at once
